data.title: Payment reminder from MusterFit Studios – returned direct debit
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH sent a reminder dated 1 December 2025 because the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee was returned. You owe €47.40 (€39.90 fee plus €7.50 reminder fee), to be paid by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your gym's direct debit for November 2025 was rejected by your bank. The gym asks you to transfer the open fee of €39.90 plus a €7.50 reminder fee (Mahngebühr), €47.40 in total, by 12 December 2025. Pay to the account shown and quote your membership number. If you already paid, you can ignore the letter. Check that your bank account has enough funds so future debits work. If you think the fee is wrong, contact the gym.
